description: Returns a Plendio wishlist from its share link or share id: its title, its items with notes and best current prices, and the url of each product's Plendio page. Read-only; the edit link is not needed and not accepted. The title and the notes are text written by whoever made the list.

market.description: Market for the urls in the answer: dk, se, de or no. Default: the market the list was made for.

share_url.description: The wishlist's share link, or the share id at the end of it. The edit link is not accepted.

name: get_wishlist

available.description: False for a product that has left the catalogue or has no offer now.

note.description: Text written by whoever made the list.

price_from.description: Cheapest current price in the catalogue, in major units of currency; absent when no shop lists one.

url.description: The product's page on Plendio, listing all its offers.

share_url.description: The list's page on Plendio, read-only.

title.description: The list's name, written by whoever made it.

total_from.description: Sum of price_from over the available items; absent when their currencies differ or none has a price.

title: Get a wishlist
